src.label: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, Trabzon Port Veterinary Border Control — conditions for cats and dogs entering Türkiye (16 May 2025, in Turkish)

head: At most 2 pets per traveller, each with a passport, health certificate and a rabies antibody test taken 3 months ahead.
lines: The ministry's veterinary border office says each cat or dog needs a microchip (or a legible tattoo), a rabies vaccination given after the chip and with an inactivated or recombinant vaccine, a passport, a veterinary health certificate from the country of origin, and the original rabies antibody titration result.

The blood sample for the titration test is taken at least 30 days after the last rabies shot, in an EU-approved lab, with at least 0.5 IU/ml, and the pet can enter Türkiye only 3 months or more after the sampling date. It is not repeated for animals whose later boosters stay within the validity of earlier ones.

A traveller may bring at most 2 animals (for example 2 cats, or 1 cat and 1 dog), each with its own set of documents. Unvaccinated animals under 3 months may be admitted if they meet health conditions the ministry sets for the country of origin.
